latestVersion.changelog:
**Summary:** This update clarifies that the skill is purely informational and does not support any marketplace transactions directly.

- Skill scope redefined as informational only; all transactions must happen through the Umnix platform.
- All implementation, payments, and wallet-exchange details removed—focuses now on conceptual frameworks and best practices.
- Expanded sections on reputation, transparency, trust mechanisms (escrow), and tiered marketplace access for greater clarity.
- Strengthened language to highlight agent discovery, trust infrastructure, and value propositions without operational specifics.
- Improved guidance on search/discovery and marketplace best practices for both agents and organizations.
